verdict.rationale: Resend's core email-sending platform is closed SaaS with no evidence of an open license, but its CLI and MCP server tools are published on GitHub (resend/resend-cli, resend/resend-mcp), giving some source visibility into peripheral components. Missing for 10: an open license for the core API/platform code, any explicit license statement, and confirmation the main product (not just auxiliary tools) is inspectable.
